ios.desc:
BibleWise is a Bible quiz game that makes learning Scripture fun and rewarding. Play three unique game modes, answer 423 Bible trivia questions, and test your knowledge of God's Word from Genesis to Revelation. No ads. No subscriptions. Just you and the Bible.

THREE WAYS TO PLAY

Adventure Mode: 10 Free Levels (60 with Premium)
Progress through Bible quiz levels across the Old Testament and New Testament. Earn up to 3 stars per level to unlock new content and prove your Scripture mastery. From Genesis creation stories to Revelation prophecy, every level deepens your Bible knowledge.

Daily Challenge
Build your streak with a new set of 10 Bible trivia questions every day. Hit milestone rewards at 3, 7, 14, and 30 days of consecutive play. Earn bonus hints for perfect scores. The daily Bible quiz takes just 2 minutes and builds a lasting habit of Scripture study.

60-Second Timed Mode
Race against the clock in this fast-paced Bible trivia challenge! Answer as many questions as possible in one minute. Choose your difficulty and compete for your personal best. Perfect for a quick Bible study break anytime, anywhere.

423 BIBLE QUESTIONS

Every question comes with an explanation, so a wrong answer teaches you something. Our Bible trivia covers:

Old Testament: Genesis and the patriarchs, Exodus and the wilderness, Major and Minor Prophets, Psalms and worship, Proverbs and wisdom, Kings, and Historical Books.

New Testament: The Gospels and life of Jesus, Acts of the Apostles, Paul's letters, General Epistles, and Revelation.

Special Topics: Biblical Characters and heroes of faith, Miracles and healings, Parables and teachings of Jesus, Messianic Prophecies and fulfillment.

SMART HINT SYSTEM

Stuck on a tough Bible question? Use hints to eliminate wrong answers and learn as you play. Earn hints through daily streaks and milestone rewards. Premium owners can also buy hint packs. Every question is a chance to learn something new about Scripture.

STAR-BASED PROGRESSION

Collect stars across all three game modes to unlock new Bible quiz levels. Your Adventure Mode stars, Daily Challenge stars, and Timed Mode best rating all contribute to your total. The more you play, the more you unlock.

WHY BIBLEWISE

I also just shipped two more apps today:

- Biblewise — a Bible trivia game I originally built for my niece and nephew but ended up  with three modes: adventure (progressive levels across 6 categories), daily challenges with streak tracking, and a timed mode. Built with SwiftUI + SwiftData, offline-first. https://apps.apple.com/us/app/biblewise-bible-quiz-game/id6758916009

- Neimr — a collaborative naming app with Tinder-style swiping. Create a survey for baby names, pet names, business names, etc., invite your partner/friends, and it finds which names you all agree on. Built with Flutter + Firebase. https://apps.apple.com/us/app/neimr-find-names-together/id6758278121

Following up the comment i made last month, I'm a solo dev building a handful of apps across different niches.

- Linetris ( https://apps.apple.com/us/app/linetris-daily-line-puzzle/id6759858457 ), a daily puzzle game where you fill an 8x8 grid with Tetris-like pieces to clear lines. Think Wordle meets Tetris. Daily challenges, leaderboards, and competititve play against friends.

- Kvile ( https://kvile.app ) — A lightweight desktop HTTP client built with Rust + Tauri. Native .http file support (JetBrains/VS Code/Kulala compatible), Monaco editor, JS pre/post scripts, SQLite-backed history. Sub-second startup. MIT licensed, no cloud, your requests stay on your machine. Think Postman without the bloat and login walls.

- Mockingjay ( https://apps.apple.com/us/app/mockingjay-secure-recorder/id6758616261 ) — iOS app that records video and streams AES-256-GCM encrypted chunks to your Google Drive in real-time. By the time someone takes your phone, the footage is already safe in the cloud. Built for journalists, activists, and anyone who needs tamper-proof evidence. Features a duress PIN that wipes local keys while preserving cloud backups, and a fake sleep mode that makes the phone look powered off during recording.

- Stao ( https://stao.app ) — A simple sit/stand reminder for standing desk users. Runs in the system tray, tracks your streaks, zero setup. Available on macOS, Windows, Linux, iOS, and Android.
